name: KUDZU GIRL
source:
Em and her best friend Brynn stop at a small town during their cross-state roadtrip. When she goes into the gas station for some food, she witnesses the town scapegoat being abused - It's rather fascinating.

[From [url=https://hexlin.itch.io/kudzu-girl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾姆与挚友布琳在跨州自驾游途中停靠在一座小镇歇脚。当她走进加油站便利店买吃的时，亲眼目睹了镇上的替罪羊遭人欺凌虐待的一幕——那场面，竟出奇地令人着迷。

[摘自[url=https://hexlin.itch.io/kudzu-girl]itch.io[/url]]
